notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures, three of which are Elves excluding Thranduil that do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate two Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters, its soulbond ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it with Thranduil.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
